title: Flat scalar evaluation on an arbitrary first complex and its derived coherence
statement:
Let $\mathcal C$ be a site small in the module universe, $\varphi:R\to S$ a morphism of commutative ring sheaves, $E=S\otimes_R-$ exact ordinary scalar extension, and $U$ termwise scalar restriction on complexes and derived categories [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category] [def-pc-sheaf-restrict-scalars]. Use unbounded localization $Q$, $E^{\mathbf L}$, normalized derived tensor-Hom structures $H_R,H_S$, and simultaneous scalar tensor comparisons with their K-flat representative square [def-weil-abstract-derived-category] [lem-pur-derived-change-of-rings] [def-coef-ringed-tensor-hom-model] [def-pur-derived-internal-hom] [def-sfb-scalar-hom-comparison-data]. Let $P$ be a flat-term K-flat $R$-complex, $J$ a K-injective $R$-complex, $D$ any $R$-complex, and $b:D\to\mathcal Hom_R^\bullet(P,J)$ a chain map [def-pc-kflat-complex] [def-pur-kinjective-complex] [def-coef-hom-representative-evaluation]. Write $\widetilde b:D\otimes_R P\to J$ for chain evaluation $x\otimes p\mapsto b(x)(p)$, and $\beta:QD\to H_R(QP,QJ)$ for its derived transpose. Put $A=S\otimes_R D$. Under the canonical exact-extension representative identifications $E^{\mathbf L}QM\cong Q(EM)$ and $S\otimes_R M\cong UEM$, the map obtained from $UE^{\mathbf L}([\widetilde b])$ by the inverse scalar tensor comparison and the scalar unit on $QP$ is represented by the actual chain map $h_b:A\otimes_R P\to UEJ$, $(s\otimes x)\otimes p\mapsto s\otimes b(x)(p)$. This assertion holds for arbitrary $D$, including $D=\mathcal Hom_R^\bullet(P,J)$; neither $D$ nor $A$ is required to be K-flat. For every flat-term K-flat resolution $t:V\to D$, the representative square for $V,P$ descends along the quasi-isomorphisms $Et$, $E(t\otimes1_P)$ and $t\otimes1_P$ to this same formula, independently of $t$.

For arbitrary derived inputs $K,L$, let $c^\varphi_{K,L}:E^{\mathbf L}H_R(K,L)\to H_S(E^{\mathbf L}K,E^{\mathbf L}L)$ be the transpose of scalar-extended evaluation, and let $\Theta$ be the evaluation-normalized scalar adjunction [lem-sfb-dc-hom-scalar-adjunction]. The derived transpose of $\Theta U(c^\varphi_{QP,QJ})\circ UE^{\mathbf L}(\beta)$ is $[h_b]$. The comparison $c^\varphi$ is natural in both arbitrary derived inputs, including morphisms represented by inverses of quasi-isomorphisms. For $R\xrightarrow{\varphi}S\xrightarrow{\psi}T$ with exact scalar extensions, $c^{\psi\varphi}$ equals $c^\psi\circ E_\psi^{\mathbf L}(c^\varphi)$ under the canonical scalar-composition identifications on its source and both Hom inputs; the identity coefficient comparison is the identity. The representative formula above respects these identifications and both paths of compatible coefficient squares. No boundedness, finite freeness or filtered-continuity hypothesis is imposed.
